messages.author: 1b500d81402bb586
messages.subject: toMathJax.xtable function for markdown chunks
parts:
Examples from the xtable gallery done using markdown.

http://rpubs.com/Thell/xtable

Most of the tables in the xtable gallery work great with the toMathJax.xtable() function that is a slightly modified toLatex.xtable() function.  The stuff you'd normally do with xtable (sanitizing, inserts at rows, row and column name control etc. can be done the same way as usual.

Implements:
  • Output hooks to wrap xtable latex with $$
  • Output hook handles 'holding' with a holdjax=TRUE option
  • Implements opts.label groups for "jax" "jaxhold" and "jaxasis"

The chunks look clean.

For example:

```{r, opts.label="jax"}
## Demonstrate sanitization
mat <- round(matrix(c(0.9, 0.89, 200, 0.045, 2.0), c(1, 5)), 4)
rownames(mat) <- "y_{t-1}"
colnames(mat) <- c("R^2", "\\bar{R}^2", "F-stat", "S.E.E", "DW")
toMathJax.xtable( xtable(mat), sanitize.text.function=function(x){x})
```

Gives just what you'd expect for Latex col/row names.

And inserting chunk output into math sections is pretty straight forward too.

$$
\begin{equation}
f(x) = \left[ \hspace2ex
```{r, opts.label="jaxasis"}
toMathJax.xtable( xtable( matrix( 1:9, 3, 3) ),
                  include.rownames=FALSE,
                  include.colnames=FALSE )
```
\hspace2ex \right]
\end{equation}
$$

A feature request has been made to xtable to allow control of the first \hline.

messages.subject: Re: [knitr] toMathJax.xtable function for markdown chunks
parts:
This is so cool!! You may also consider if you can extend
knitr::kable(): https://github.com/yihui/knitr/blob/master/R/table.R
It is pretty weak at the moment but should satisfy our demand for
tables reasonably well. There are certainly some missing parts
compared to xtable.

Regards,
Yihui
